name: Exposed database credentials
evidence: Offline desktop app with no database server; data is local JSON files (framelytix-project.json, settings.json).
verification: Source review of electron/ and shared/: no DB client or connection strings.

name: Public .env files
evidence: .gitignore excludes .env and .env.*; no .env file exists or is tracked; packaged files list is out/** only.
verification: git ls-files scan for .env/.pem/.key/.pfx returned nothing.

name: Hardcoded API keys or secrets
evidence: No API keys, tokens or passwords exist in the design (no network services). Pattern scan (AWS, GitHub, OpenAI-style, Slack, Google, private-key blocks, password literals) of all tracked files found none.

name: Weak or missing authentication
evidence: Single-user local application with no accounts or remote access; OS account login is the boundary.
verification: Source review: no auth routes or sign-in code.

name: Missing server-side authorization
evidence: The trusted boundary is the Electron main process. electron/ipc/handle.ts accepts IPC only from the main window's top frame at the app:// origin, validates args with Zod, and every file operation goes through resolveInsideRoot.
verification: tests/integration/paths.test.ts; code review of handle.ts isTrustedSender.

name: Cross-user data access
evidence: No multi-user or multi-tenant data; projects are files the local user chooses.

name: Open database permissions
evidence: No database.

name: Misconfigured Firebase / Supabase / S3
evidence: No cloud storage or backend services; network requests blocked in electron/security/hardening.ts.
verification: E2E test asserts zero http(s) requests.

name: Unprotected admin routes
evidence: No server or admin interface.

name: Production debug tools exposed
evidence: DevTools disabled when packaged (mainWindow.ts devTools: !app.isPackaged). Originally the packaged exe still honoured ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE, NODE_OPTIONS and --inspect. FRAMELYTIX_TEST_USER_DATA applies only when unpackaged.
fix: Added electronFuses in electron-builder.yml: runAsNode, NODE_OPTIONS and inspect disabled; asar-only loading with integrity validation.
verification: npx @electron/fuses read on release/win-unpacked/FrameLytix.exe shows all fuses as configured.

name: Build logs leaking secrets
evidence: Workflows use no secrets except the auto-masked GITHUB_TOKEN in the draft-release step; no step prints environment or tokens.
verification: Review of .github/workflows/ci.yml and release.yml; CI run #2 annotations show no secret output.

name: Verbose production errors
evidence: electron/ipc/handle.ts returns only UserFacingError/PathSecurityError messages or a generic message; details go to the bounded local log. React ErrorBoundary shows a safe message.
verification: Code review; E2E asserts no renderer page errors.

name: Secrets in Git history
evidence: All 3+ commits scanned with secret patterns; no matches. History contains only source and generated sample assets.

name: Secrets shipped in frontend JavaScript
evidence: No secrets exist anywhere in the project; renderer bundle contains only app code and libraries.
verification: Secret pattern scan of tracked files; architecture review.

name: Client-side-only security checks
evidence: Main process re-validates everything: Zod schemas per IPC channel, path containment, blocked file types checked in main (fileService.ts, filesIpc.ts), export open/reveal limited to files exported this session.

name: Missing input validation
evidence: Zod validation on every IPC call (bounded strings and arrays) and on project manifests and settings (shared/schemas). Expression parser is a restricted grammar, no eval.
verification: tests/unit/expression.test.ts; schema tests; npm test 376 passed.

name: SQL injection
evidence: No SQL database.

name: NoSQL injection
evidence: No NoSQL database or query language.

name: Cross-site scripting (XSS)
evidence: React escaping throughout; single dangerouslySetInnerHTML is KaTeX output with trust:false (Equation.tsx). Report HTML built with escapeHtml and previewed in a sandbox iframe; PDF window runs with JavaScript disabled. CSP script-src 'self'.
verification: grep for dangerouslySetInnerHTML/innerHTML/eval; report builder tests; E2E asserts exported HTML has no <script>.

name: Cross-site request forgery (CSRF)
evidence: No web server or cookie-authenticated endpoints; IPC accepts only the app's own top frame.

name: Insecure file uploads
evidence: Import is copy-only into the project, with size (2 GB) and count (500) caps, collision handling and blocked executable types. The blocked list missed several risky types (.chm, .msix, .settingcontent-ms, .vhdx, .pkg, .desktop and others).
fix: Expanded BLOCKED_EXTENSIONS in electron/security/paths.ts; added test cases.

name: Path traversal
evidence: resolveInsideRoot rejects absolute, UNC, device and drive paths, '..' variants, ADS and NUL, and canonicalises with realpath so symlinks and junctions cannot escape.

name: Server-side request forgery (SSRF)
evidence: No server; all http/https/ws/ftp requests are cancelled in hardening.ts.

name: Broken password-reset flows
evidence: No accounts or passwords.

name: Weak session management
evidence: No login sessions.

name: Weak or incorrectly validated JWTs
evidence: No tokens.

name: Overly permissive CORS
evidence: No HTTP API; custom app:// and framelytix-asset:// protocols serve local files to the app only.

name: Missing rate limits
evidence: No network endpoints; local IPC is bounded by payload limits (see 64).

name: Unprotected staging or test environments
evidence: No hosted environments. Tests use temp folders and synthetic fixtures only.

name: Default credentials left unchanged
evidence: No credentials of any kind.

name: Webhook signatures not verified
evidence: No webhooks.

name: Frontend-only payment checks
evidence: Free open-source app with no payments.

name: IDOR / BOLA
evidence: No multi-user objects; file access is limited to the open project root.

name: APIs trusting user-controlled roles or IDs
evidence: No roles or identities.

name: Sensitive data in logs
evidence: electron/services/logger.ts logs only channel names and error messages (may include local file paths, never project contents), capped at about 1 MB plus one rotated file, local only. Disclosed in PRIVACY.md.
verification: Code review of logger and all logger calls.

name: Sensitive source maps or build artifacts
evidence: '!**/*.map' already excluded maps, but the package shipped about 130 MB of unused node_modules (including native @napi-rs/canvas binaries for 9 platforms).
fix: Main/preload now bundle their dependencies (electron.vite.config.ts externalizeDeps:false) and electron-builder.yml excludes node_modules. app.asar is 10.7 MB instead of 136 MB.
verification: asar listing: 0 .map files and 0 node_modules entries; bundle smoke-tested (sample, PDF, STL, KaTeX, PDF export).

name: Vulnerable or abandoned dependencies
evidence: npm audit reported 6 moderate advisories (minimatch ReDoS GHSA-g3hv-75wg-m249) through electron-builder, build-time only.
fix: Scoped package.json overrides pin minimatch ^11.0.9 under app-builder-lib and @electron/universal; Dependabot added.
verification: npm audit: found 0 vulnerabilities; packaging still succeeds.

name: Malicious or compromised packages
evidence: package-lock.json with integrity hashes and npm ci in CI; install scripts reviewed (electron binary download, electron-winstaller 7z selection). No full provenance review of all transitive packages was done.
fix: Consider npm audit signatures and periodic review.

name: Prompt injection
evidence: No AI features in the app.

name: AI tools bypassing user permissions
evidence: No AI tools in the app.

name: Excess database privileges
evidence: No database.

name: Missing audit logs
evidence: Single-user local app with no privileged multi-user actions. Revision history and export history exist for user convenience (documented as not tamper-proof); rejected IPC calls are logged.

name: No security monitoring or alerts
evidence: No hosted service to monitor; the app sends no telemetry by design.

name: No tested backup / restore plan
evidence: Atomic saves, rolling backups (3 to 50, default 10) and corrupted-manifest recovery in recoveryService.ts.
verification: Integration tests for backups and recovery pass.

name: Public internal dashboards
evidence: No dashboards or hosted services.

name: Missing security headers
evidence: app:// responses send the CSP and X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff; asset responses send a restrictive ASSET_CSP and nosniff. Same CSP also injected as a meta tag. HSTS not applicable (no HTTPS server).
verification: Code review of protocols.ts and csp.ts.

name: Unsafe cookie settings
evidence: The app sets no cookies. The cookie-encryption fuse is now enabled as defence in depth.

name: Sensitive data unprotected in transit / at rest
evidence: Nothing is transmitted. Project files are ordinary user documents stored where the user chooses, protected by OS account permissions and any OS disk encryption; no regulated data is processed.

name: Poor tenant isolation
evidence: No tenants.

name: Over-trusting AI-generated code
evidence: Most source code was written by an AI assistant and this audit was also performed by an AI assistant. There are 376 unit/integration and 22 E2E tests, but no independent human security review.
fix: Have a qualified human review electron/ (IPC handlers and path security) before wider distribution.
verification: Not verified by an independent reviewer.

name: Mass assignment / over-posting
evidence: Manifests and settings are parsed with strict Zod schemas (unknown keys stripped); IPC handlers take fixed typed tuples.

name: Command / OS injection
evidence: No child_process use; shell.openPath hands a file to its registered handler without a command line. Opening .py, .pyw, .pl or .rb files could execute them through a default association.
fix: Added isBlockedForOpen (open-only block for interpreted scripts; import still allowed) and expanded the blocked list.
verification: New test 'allows importing scripts but never opens them' passes.

name: Unsafe deserialization
evidence: JSON.parse plus Zod validation; size caps (200 MB manifest); newer schema versions rejected; no executable object formats.

name: Misconfigured OAuth / OIDC / social login
evidence: No sign-in.

name: No MFA on privileged accounts
evidence: The GitHub account that owns the repository and release workflow could not be inspected.
fix: Owner: enable two-factor authentication on the GitHub account.

name: Account enumeration
evidence: No accounts.

name: Business-logic abuse
evidence: No prices, credits, quotas or entitlements. Decision-matrix rules are enforced in shared/utilities and tested.

name: Race conditions
evidence: Serialised saves, atomic temp-file-then-rename writes, project lock file and external-change detection.
verification: Integration tests for saves and locks pass.

name: Webhook replay / duplicate processing
evidence: No webhooks.

name: Overpowered CI/CD credentials
evidence: Workflow default permissions contents: read; contents: write only in the tag-only draft-release job. actions/checkout kept the token in .git/config by default.
fix: Set persist-credentials: false on every checkout.
verification: Review of ci.yml and release.yml after edit.

name: Untrusted build actions or scripts
evidence: Only official actions/* actions are used; npm install scripts inventoried (electron binary download, electron-winstaller). Repository build scripts are first-party.

name: Unpinned build dependencies
evidence: npm used a lockfile and npm ci, but GitHub Actions were referenced by mutable tags (@v4) running on deprecated Node 20.
fix: Pinned checkout, setup-node, upload-artifact and download-artifact to full commit SHAs of their latest releases (Node 24); Dependabot keeps them current.
verification: git ls-remote SHA lookup; action.yml inputs checked at each SHA.

name: Security checks fail open
evidence: Untrusted IPC sender or invalid args lead to rejection; path errors throw PathSecurityError; unparsable request URLs are cancelled; permission request and check handlers deny everything; window.open denied; navigation away blocked.
verification: Code review of handle.ts and hardening.ts; tests.

name: Missing resource limits
evidence: Caps on IPC arrays and strings, import (500 files, 2 GB), manifest and backups (200 MB), CSV (50 MB), report images (40 x 5 MB), notices (4 MB), log (1 MB), PDF render timeout (60 s).

name: AI sensitive-information disclosure
evidence: No AI features.

name: Unsafe use of AI output
evidence: No AI output is consumed at runtime.

name: AI agents have excessive agency
evidence: No AI agents in the app.

name: Sensitive browser storage
evidence: No localStorage, sessionStorage or IndexedDB use; state lives in main-process files.

name: Open redirects
evidence: will-navigate and will-redirect block any URL outside app:// (or the dev server); setWindowOpenHandler denies all new windows; webviews blocked.

name: Unsecured GraphQL / WebSocket / realtime endpoints
evidence: No GraphQL or realtime endpoints; ws/wss requests are cancelled in production.
